To get started with styling, all you need is damp hair! Just distribute the foam evenly through damp hair, scrunch upwards to encourage your wave pattern, and either air dry or diffuse.
If you want to build out a complete routine later, pairing the foam with a hydrating shampoo and conditioner or a wave-reviving mist is a great next step, but the foam alone is all you need to start.
